# WorldPulse Modkit

> Make mods for the colony sim WorldPulse with any AI assistant. Mods are JSON defs and text pixel art.

- [Small bundle](bundle/modding-small.md): rules, field tables, workflows and examples in ~11k tokens, for small models
- [Full bundle](bundle/modding-full.md): every doc, workflow and role card in one file
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): the rules an assistant must follow
- [Concepts](docs/concepts.md): ids, kinds, load order, overriding, units
- [Field reference](docs/api/): every field of every def kind
- [Limits](docs/limits.md): what needs a game update
